title: High Honors
description: According to Madison College scholastic records, this individual has achieved a grade point average of 3.75 or better. This accomplishment earns a place on the Dean's List at Madison Area Technical College for the associated term. In our competitive society, academic honors are not easily achieved. This recognition is proof of your ability, perseverance, dedication, and hard work.
Criteria: Grade point average of 3.75 or better

title: Core Workforce Skills: Teamwork (v.02)
description: Core Workforce Skills are a collection of soft skills employers list as important. To earn this badge, instructors rate a student artifact or assignment produced in a course that targets Teamwork. Examples of artifacts include a research paper, group presentation, project, or skill demonstration. Badges are awarded when adequate evidence is present. The skills are measured through observable behavior or performance.
Criteria: Work cooperatively to support common goals
Contribute to group with ideas, suggestions, and effort
Complete own share of tasks necessary to complete a project
Empower team members by active listening and validating other's contributions

title: Web Accessibility Fundamentals (v.01)
description: The curriculum provides an overview of important web accessibility concepts, including technical standards and user experience fundamentals. Students investigate different disabilities and their related challenges. Topics include an explanation of WCAG guidelines, WAI-ARIA, universal design, and best coding practices. Students implement these concepts in a fully accessible website.
Criteria: Student must earn a 93% or above on accessibility quiz.
Student must earn a 93% or above on final project demonstrating full comprehension of course objectives.
